name: Reference links help
description: Help mode entries for the Reference links plugin (help@1): its settings tab, the on / off switch and the try box.
author: Brett

entries.title: Reference links settings
entries.text: Text in the banners that names a part of the app (a screen, a settings page, a plugin, a toolbar, a build, a PR, a file) is a dotted link. Tap it to see what it is and whether a build is changing it, double-tap to open it, hold or right-click for more.

entries.title: Link mentions in banner text
entries.text: On: mentions in banner text are links. Off: banner text is plain on this device.

entries.title: Try it
entries.text: Type a line of text to see which words become links and where they lead.
